## Feeds and groups

Feeds give members a reason to come back. Read the [social.plus feed docs](https://www.social.plus/social/feed) for the details.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the most important community feature?

An activity feed, because it gives members a reason to return every day. See [feeds](https://www.social.plus/social/feed).

### How many features does an app need at launch?

- Start with a feed and groups.
- Add moderation before you open to the public.

## Conclusion

Ship the feed first.
